The main takeaway from our work is that
Val-292 is a critical residue in the nicotnamide binding pocket of liver alcohol dehyrogenase.
the V292S substitution in the nicotnamide binding pocket of liver ADH increases the rate of hydride transfer by 2 orders of magnitude.
